nodes.natural_language: For every real number $x_1$, construct the sequence $x_1,x_2,\ldots$ by setting $x_{n+1}=x_n \left(x_n + \frac{1}{n}\right)$ for each $n \geq 1$.  Prove that there exists exactly one value of $x_1$ for which $0<x_n<x_{n+1}<1$ for every $n$.
